newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - May 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - May 22.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- Prosecutors are planning to indict without physical detention eight to nine politicians today in connection with the Hanbo corruption scandal.
- Law-enforcement authorities are investigating about 70 government officials and heads of local governments for alleged corruption and other misdeeds, a top blue house official said.
- Foreign Minister Yoo Chong-ha has called for the U.N. security council's increased role in handling growing numbers of refugeess worldwide, including a potential refugee outflow from North Korea.

- Collective bargaining between labor and management is proceeding more smoothly than expected and indications are that trade unions recognise that the economic slump is taking its toll on most companies.
